svg.title: Resolving across the two sites
svg.desc: vm-app asks Azure DNS for an onprem.lab32.internal name; the ruleset frs-onprem matches the domain, so the outbound endpoint out-hub asks vm-dns on port 53. In the other direction vm-dns's dnsmasq forwards azure.lab32.internal names to the inbound endpoint in-hub, which answers from the private zone where vm-app registered itself.
